events.name: Bash
events.head: Check fix on origin, files, audit status, probe harness
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -1; git log --oneline -1 origin/main; git merge-base --is-ancestor 62dff8d origin/main && echo fix-on-origin; ls cloud/src/jobs-s1.ts app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs; grep -nE "G098|G099|G104|G105|G110|G011|X016" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | grep -o "^[0-9]*:| [GX][0-9]* .\{0,0\}\|fixed[^|]*" | head -20; head -40 app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs | grep -nE "PORT|wrangler|sim|8[0-9]{3}" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check auto blocks and gcp client wiring
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -nE "kind: \"(auto|you)\"|auto:|job:" app/src/content/guides/s1-traffic/s1-cold-email.ts app/src/content/guides/s1-traffic/s1-cold-calendar.ts app/src/content/guides/s1-traffic/s1-blog.ts app/src/content/guides/s2-landing/s2-tantra-pro-funnel.ts | head -30; grep -nE "gcp_client_id|drive_client|gcp_client_secret_enc" cloud/src/*.ts | head -15; grep -n "^export\|registerJob\|id: \"" cloud/src/jobs-s1.ts | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate gcp client reads and job references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -nE "gcp_client_id|gcp_client_secret_enc" cloud/src/*.ts | head -10; grep -cE "job: \"(dns-check|gcp-service-accounts|outreach-sync|ga4-gate)\"|\"(dns-check|gcp-service-accounts|outreach-sync|ga4-gate)\"" app/src/content/guides/s1-traffic/*.ts app/src/content/guides/s2-landing/s2-tantra-pro-funnel.ts app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts cloud/src/jobs-s1.ts cloud/src/index.ts; ls cloud/scripts/ | grep -iE "sim|vendor" | head; ls -d cloud/migrations | head -1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find job registration and card wiring
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -nE "^\s*\"?[a-z0-9-]+\"?: \{ *(title|label|run)|case \"" cloud/src/jobs-s1.ts | head -12; grep -nE "dns-check|gcp-service-accounts|outreach-sync|ga4-gate" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts cloud/src/jobs.ts cloud/src/index.ts app/src/app/onboarding/centre/*.tsx | head -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read probe usage and stack config
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 1,14p app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs; grep -nE "SIM_PORT|argv|port" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -5; grep -nE "SIM_URL|_BASE|vars|\[env" cloud/wrangler.toml | head -15; ls cloud/.dev.vars* 2>/dev/null

events.text: Checking how the probe stack is started, then running it fresh.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how prior run started local centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls cloud/wrangler* ; grep -rnE "admin/enter|SIM_BASE|VENDOR_SIM|--var" app/scripts/run-chain.sh cloud/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -8; grep -o '"[^"]*wrangler dev[^"]*"' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-258.json | tail -3; grep -oE 'ADMIN[A-Z_]*|SIM[A-Z_]*' cloud/.dev.vars | sort -u

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read run-dev script and enter route
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; cat scripts/run-dev.sh | head -20; grep -n "admin/enter" src/index.ts | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read enter route and probe sign-in
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; sed -n 1041,1056p src/index.ts; sed -n 14,40p ../app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs | grep -nE "enter|token|ADMIN" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start fresh simulator and local centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; P=/tmp/t258v; rm -rf $P; mkdir -p $P; SIM_PORT=8922 SIM_STATE=$P/sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > $P/sim.log 2>&1 & echo sim $! > $P/pids; nohup npx wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --local --persist-to $P/d1 --port 8923 --ip 127.0.0.1 --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8922 --var READER_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8922/reader/ --var PUBLIC_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8923 > $P/wr.log 2>&1 & echo wr $! >> $P/pids; cat $P/pids

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply migrations to fresh D1 and wait for servers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; DB=$(grep -oE '"database_name": *"[^"]+"' wrangler.jsonc | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); echo $DB; npx wrangler d1 migrations apply $DB --local --persist-to /tmp/t258v/d1 --config wrangler.jsonc 2>&1 | tail -3; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8923/admin/enter | grep -q 200 && break; sleep 2; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "centre %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8923/admin/enter; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "sim %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8922/__state
